images.prompt: Vintage pen-and-ink engraving illustration, fine cross-hatching and stippling, etched linework like a 19th-century book plate, with subtle muted watercolor washes in ochre, sage and dusty blue, on warm cream aged paper. The subject sits in the center surrounded by plain empty cream paper, no border, no frame. Correct natural anatomy and hands. No text, letters, numbers, signatures or watermarks.
